zh: 可信的排班，不只要顯示班次；工時、薪資估算與跨夜班都必須可驗證。
en: Reliable schedules require verifiable hours, pay estimates, and overnight handling.

zh: Gemini 只提出候選資料；Schema 驗證與人工逐筆確認守住正式寫入。
en: Gemini proposes candidates. Validation and explicit human review guard every confirmed write.

zh: RAG 提供頁碼引用，也會拒絕薄弱或衝突的證據；LangGraph 合併事實與規章。
en: RAG cites pages and refuses weak evidence. LangGraph combines deterministic facts with policy.

zh: RLS、唯讀 MCP、Calendar 最小權限、ICS fallback、WIF 與受限 Cloud Run。
en: RLS, read-only MCP, least-privilege Calendar, ICS fallback, WIF, and bounded Cloud Run.

zh: 失敗案例保持可見；合成離線評估是方向性證據，不是正式人資或法律系統。
en: Failures stay visible. Synthetic offline evaluations are evidence—not HR or legal readiness.
